subject: GCP private offer — lockbox schedule & post-sale runbook (Acme Analytics)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Li <emma@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: GCP private offer — lockbox schedule & post-sale runbook (Acme Analytics)

Hi Emma —

Congrats again on getting the Private Offer across the finish line. To help ACME's procurement and finance teams transition from the signing milestone to regular redemptions, I attached a short lockbox/runbook draft and the commit schedule (v3). Key asks from our side: 

- Can your procurement contact confirm the preferred monthly redemption window (first 5 business days vs. OOB date)?
- Please confirm the invoice remediation contact for AP (name + email).

High-level plan we propose (short):
1) Week 0 (post-sign): DocuSign finalization & finance handoff.
2) Week 1: Lockbox activation (GCP marketplace) — Redwood routes drawdown to lockbox account on agreed dates.
3) Monthly thereafter: Redwood issues usage reconciliation + invoice; lockbox distributes per contract.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute runthrough with your AP team this week — Marissa and Ben will join to review the steps and sample reconciliation.

Attached: Acme_Lockbox_Instructions.pdf (high-level steps) and commit_schedule_v3.xlsx (monthly burn table).

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Emma Li <emma@acme-analytics.com>

Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — lockbox schedule & post-sale runbook (Acme Analytics)

Thanks, Soojin —

Appreciate the docs. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- ACME prefers the redemption window to be the first 3 business days of each month. Can you confirm Redwood can support that cadence?
- Our AP lead is Tara Nguyen (tara.nguyen@acme-analytics.com). She'll need the invoice examples and a short FAQ to onboard the team.

Also: is there any manual step on Redwood's side to toggle between lockbox and direct billing should we need a temporary waiver? We might request a one-off change in Q1.

Emma
Emma Li
Director, Cloud Procurement
Acme Analytics
emma@acme-analytics.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
To: Emma Li <emma@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — lockbox schedule & post-sale runbook (Acme Analytics)

Thanks, Emma —

Quick answers inline: 
- First 3 business days: yes, Redwood supports that. We will instruct the GCP marketplace redemption to target the lockbox on day 1, day 2, and day 3 (or the next business day if a holiday/weekend).
- We'll send Tara a 1-page invoice sample + FAQ (attached below).
- Temporary waiver / direct billing: the platform supports a manual toggle but it requires a 48–72 hour ops window and an approval from our finance team (we'll need a signed change order or an email confirmation from your procurement lead). Karthik is copied to own the waiver process and timing.

Action items I have captured: 
- Soojin: send invoice sample + short FAQ to Tara (by EOD PST).
- Marissa: organize 30-min AP onboarding session and include burn reconciliation template.
- Ben/Karthik: coordinate the operational steps for lockbox toggle & note the 48–72 hour lead time.

I'll attach the invoice sample and the updated lockbox instructions now.

Best,
Soojin
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: [Internal] Acme — runbook + prep for AP session (Nov 4)

Team —

Summarizing next steps ahead of tomorrow's 30-min call with Tara/Nina from Acme's AP: 

Attachments included for reference: Acme_Lockbox_Instructions.pdf, commit_schedule_v3.xlsx, invoice_sample_acme.pdf

Prep checklist: 
- Marissa: run the 30-min onboarding (slides + walkthrough), pull the burn reconciliation template (sheet tab: 'Monthly Reconcile').
- Ben: be ready to explain marketplace redemption mechanics and where lockbox funds land; bring an example ledger export.
- Karthik: map the timeout/waiver workflow and be prepared to note the 48–72 hour ops window; confirm who in finance approves change orders.

Escalation path (if AP flags missing charges): 
1) Redwood Ops (Ben) — immediate investigation, publish reconciliation within 48 hours.
2) Finance (Karthik) — issues >$5k escalate to finance director; will coordinate any netting/adjustment.
3) Legal (Marissa) — contract interpretation questions.

I'll join the call and capture acceptance of the monthly window (first 3 business days) so we can lock the schedule in HubSpot and create the monthly automated emails to ACME.

Soojin
